t: What is the Meaning of Buy to Open (BTO)?
s: October 28, 2025 - Buy to Open (or BTO) refers to an opening position that a trader could take in stocks, call options, and put options. Brokerages refer to BTO when a trader takes a long opening position in a call or put option or in shares.
